levels.surface: محمد بن عبيد بن ميمون أبو عبيد المديني

notes: «حدثنا أبي» : the bare father of the first link is a relation, not completed
«سألت عبد الله بن عباس وعبد الله بن عمر ... فقالا» : both are asked and both answer, so they are one level of two co-transmitters (rule 5)
the saying is the two Companions' answer on the night prayer; no Prophetic words are relayed directly
